plain: A small district or region of a country, as in Switzerland.

webster.text: A small portion of land, or division of territory; originally, a portion of territory on a border; also, the inhabitants of a canton.

example.quote: The connection among the Swiss cantons scarcely amounts to a confederacy; though it is sometimes cited as an instance of the stability of such institutions.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 19 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 8, 1787
